note: Original models: results from reports/ (Training_History.xlsx, per-class reports). Improved models: results exported by the Colab notebooks Bird_Image_Training_v4.ipynb and Bird_Audio_Training_v2.ipynb.

original.caveat: Random file-level split on a dataset where 749 of 1,679 files are exact duplicates; simulation of this split shows about 60% (52-70%) of test files have an identical copy in training, so this value overstates accuracy on new recordings.

improved.caveat: Duplicate files removed (930 unique recordings) and split by recording, so every test recording is unseen. Small test set: 1 recording = about 1 percentage point.
